notes: The proprietary YouTube IPA is not stored in this repository.
The audited output preserves every original IPA entry except the main executable and adds only Frameworks/VancedCore.dylib; all other existing ZIP payloads remain byte-identical.
The main executable intentionally has its stale LC_CODE_SIGNATURE removed before injection and requires a full recursive re-sign before installation.
Google account login after third-party re-signing is not yet implemented/proven; SSO/keychain/app-group behavior is signing-identity dependent.
Push notifications after re-signing depend on the signing profile and APS entitlement even though all five original app extensions are preserved.
The repository MODULES=jailed IPA packaging path is not validated because the pinned dependency set does not install the external theos-jailed module.
No Premium entitlement, ad-service bypass, or restricted background-playback entitlement bypass is included.
